status_note: Real EXTERNAL production adaptation to the POI 5 byte-array cap, DISCOVERED BY THE PIPELINE (bbc_e2e.py mine-commits). Signature is causally clean: setByteArrayMaxOverride is a POI-5-only API AND the commit message names the exact exception it avoids. Differential not run: the client is Scala/sbt (our Java+Maven harness does not apply) and the POI break is parser-internal (needs a crafted oversized workbook, not a standalone mimic).
discovery_method: bbc_e2e.py run poi-4.1.2-to-5.x -> mine-commits q='poi setByteArrayMaxOverride' -> classify (production, not library-source). First case found end-to-end by the automated pipeline.

bump_source.comment: Break characterized from BUMP (dadoonet/fscrawler POI 4.1.2->5.x TEST_FAILUREs).

behavioral_break.mechanism: POI 5.0 introduced a default maximum byte-array size in org.apache.poi.util.IOUtils; reading a record/stream larger than the default throws org.apache.poi.util.RecordFormatException at runtime. Compiles fine against POI 5 -> behavioural, not syntactic. Fix: raise the cap via IOUtils.setByteArrayMaxOverride(n), an API that exists ONLY in POI 5.

adaptation.repo_note: Frugal Mechanic FlatFile — a Scala flat-file/Excel reading library (sbt build).
adaptation.in_repo_causal_evidence: The commit message explicitly states the call is to AVOID org.apache.poi.util.RecordFormatException — direct attribution to the POI 5 byte-cap behaviour.
adaptation.summary: Raised POI's byte-array cap to ~1e9 in the production Excel reader to cope with POI 5's new default limit.

verification.method: signature only (POI-5-only API + exact exception named in the commit message)
differential_blockers: Client is Scala/sbt — the Java+Maven harness (scratchpad/*-harness) does not apply; would need an sbt harness.

POI byte-cap break is parser-internal (enforced deep in record parsing), so it does not reproduce from a standalone top-level mimic; a faithful differential needs a crafted oversized workbook fed through the client's real ExcelFlatFileReader.
verification.conclusion: Signature-confirmed real external PRODUCTION adaptation to the POI 5 byte-cap, found automatically by the pipeline. Full differential out of scope (Scala build + parser-internal break).

pipeline_note: First dataset entry produced end-to-end by bbc_e2e.py. Also validated two classifier fixes in this run: (1) library-fork filter — apache/poi and its forks matched the POI-API commit search but are the API DEFINITION not a client CALL, now tagged library_source and excluded; (2) Scala/Kotlin + top-level-module path detection — fm-flatfile's src/main/scala file was initially missed by a .java-only, leading-slash path check.
